slides.headline: What must leave the field now?
slides.body: Separate urgent thresholds from routine telemetry that can wait, batch or retry.

slides.headline: Where does the device really operate?
slides.body: Use property conditions, terrain and movement—not the nearest town—as the design input.

slides.headline: What is the power budget?
slides.body: Reporting frequency and network behaviour must fit the device's energy model.

slides.headline: What happens offline?
slides.body: Define local control, storage, retry and operator visibility before choosing the communications path.

slides.headline: Map the field conditions
slides.body: Turn operating reality into a Hybrid IoT readiness brief.
